parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Solid potassium manganate(VII), $\text{KMnO}_4$, decomposes on heating to form manganese(IV) oxide, potassium manganate(VI) and a colourless gas.

Construct an equation for this reaction.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain the origin of colour in transition element complexes.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem:
The reaction scheme shows some reactions of $\text{[Cu(H}_2\text{O)}_6\text{]}^{2+}$.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

$\text{[Cu(H}_2\text{O)}_6\text{]}^{2+} \xrightarrow[\text{NaOH(aq)}]{\text{reaction 1}} \text{precipitate A} \xrightarrow[\text{excess NH}_3\text{(aq)}]{\text{reaction 2}} \text{solution of B}$

$\text{[Cu(H}_2\text{O)}_6\text{]}^{2+} \xrightarrow{\text{reaction 3}} \text{CuCO}_3\text{(s)} \xrightarrow[\text{CH}_3\text{CO}_2\text{H(aq)}]{\text{reaction 4}} \text{solution of C}$

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text:
Write the formulae of

compound C.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Identify a suitable reagent for reaction 3.

parts.label: (d)(iv)
parts.text: Describe **two** visual observations that would be made during reaction 4.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Platin, $\text{Pt(NH}_3\text{)}_2\text{Cl}_2$, is a neutral complex of platinum(II).

Explain why $\text{Pt(NH}_3\text{)}_2\text{Cl}_2$ has no charge.

parts.label: (f)(i)
parts.text:
$\text{Pt(NH}_3\text{)}_2\text{Cl}_2$, displays cis-trans isomerism.

Draw the structure of trans-platin. State its shape and the $\text{Cl}-\text{Pt}-\text{Cl}$ bond angle.

parts.label: (f)(ii)
parts.text:
Cis-platin is an effective anti-cancer drug.

Describe the action of cis-platin in this role.

parts.label: (g)
parts.text:
The use of cis-platin can cause side effects so nedaplatin has been developed.

Nedaplatin can be synthesised from cis-platin, $\text{Pt(NH}_3\text{)}_2\text{Cl}_2$, by replacing the two chloride ion ligands with a **single** bidentate ligand as shown.

Suggest the structure for nedaplatin.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}
